title: Never retype a table from a screenshot again
caption:
Never retype a table from a screenshot again 📊

ChatGPT can turn a screenshot into a table:
✅ Click the + button and upload the screenshot
✅ Type: turn this into a table
✅ Want it in Excel? Ask for a CSV file and download it
⚠️ Always check the numbers before you use them

What would you turn into a table first? 👇
Follow for daily Windows + AI tips.
